_comment: Aggregate gauges for the AI-credit tracker, fetched from Yahoo (unmetered).
Deliberately index funds rather than individual companies. The thesis names
specific asset managers and insurers as the risk channel, but a dashboard row
implying a named firm is systemically dangerous is a strong public claim, and the
ownership assertions behind it are not independently verified here. Sector-level
gauges show the same stress without naming anyone.

gauges.label: Business development companies
gauges.note: An index of listed BDCs - the visible slice of private credit.

gauges.label: High-yield bonds
gauges.note: Public junk credit, the comparison for whether stress is private-credit specific.

gauges.label: Insurance sector
gauges.note: Insurance industry index, used against financials generally.

gauges.label: Data centre REIT (Equinix)
gauges.note: Weak proxy for the buildout: hyperscaler capex has no free source.
